content: Guidance UX: adaptive/context-aware checklists are the current standard and outperform scripted tours because they respect autonomy; best implementations reorder/add/remove steps based on what the user already discovered organically. Guidance must be skippable/dismissible and anchored to an activation moment. Trust in AI-derived suggestions depends on explainability: users who cannot see why a suggestion was made ignore it; why-you-are-seeing-this links, provenance pointing back to source items, and interpretable confidence indicators calibrate trust. High acceptance with low explanation engagement signals trust miscalibration.
